notes.title: Store Page of new game "Cloudside Lane" is now open
notes.notes: [p][b]Cloudside Lane[/b] is a small casual building game.[/p][p]Immerse yourself in a tranquil  and comfortable environment, [/p][p]build houses and create your own cozy streetscape.[/p][p]There are no scores or rules here, just follow your heart to create and feel.[/p][p][img src="https://shared.st.dl.eccdnx.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3842880/5f33392be3a6f77d135689189ca290775fba6b05/ss_5f33392be3a6f77d135689189ca290775fba6b05.800x600.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The development of the game is currently nearing completion, [/p][p]and it is planned to be launched in 2025.[/p][p]The Steam store page is now open. [b]Welcome to add to your wishlist[/b].[/p][p]Thanks very much for your attention and support！[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842880/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
